```artifact
Feature: Doctor Management

  Scenario: Add a new Doctor
    Given the system is running
    When a new Doctor with the following details is added:
      | Name     | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience | Speciality |
      | Dr. John | 45  | M   | MD            | 10         | Cardiology |
    Then the Doctor should be added successfully
    And the Doctor's details should be displayed

  Scenario: View and Update Doctor Details
    Given a Doctor with the following details exists:
      | Name     | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience | Speciality |
      | Dr. John | 45  | M   | MD            | 10         | Cardiology |
    When the Doctor's details are viewed
    Then the Doctor's details should be displayed
    When the Doctor's Speciality is updated to "Neurology"
    Then the Doctor's Speciality should not be updated
    And the Doctor's details should be displayed with the updated Speciality

  Scenario: Delete Doctor Details
    Given a Doctor with the following details exists:
      | Name     | Age | Sex | Qualification | Experience | Speciality |
      | Dr. John | 45  | M   | MD            | 10         | Cardiology |
    And no new Patient Consultation Request is pending for the Doctor
    When the Doctor's details are deleted
    Then the Doctor's details should be deleted
    And the Doctor should no longer be displayed

  Scenario: Add a new Chemist or Lab
    Given the system is running
    When a new Chemist with the following details is added:
      | Name     | Pincode | Address       |
      | Chemist1 | 12345   | 123 Main St   |
    Then the Chemist should be added successfully
    And the Chemist's details should be displayed
    When a new Lab with the following details is added:
      | Name     | Pincode | Address       |
      | Lab1     | 12345   | 456 Elm St    |
    Then the Lab should be added successfully
    And the Lab's details should be displayed

  Scenario: View and Update Chemist/Lab Details
    Given a Chemist with the following details exists:
      | Name     | Pincode | Address       |
      | Chemist1 | 12345   | 123 Main St   |
    When the Chemist's details are viewed
    Then the Chemist's details should be displayed
    When the Chemist's Pincode is updated to "54321"
    Then the Chemist's Pincode should not be updated
    And the Chemist's details should be displayed with the updated Pincode
    Given a Lab with the following details exists:
      | Name     | Pincode | Address       |
      | Lab1     | 12345   | 456 Elm St    |
    When the Lab's details are viewed
    Then the Lab's details should be displayed
    When the Lab's Pincode is updated to "54321"
    Then the Lab's Pincode should not be updated
    And the Lab's details should be displayed with the updated Pincode

  Scenario: Delete Chemist/Lab Details
    Given a Chemist with the following details exists:
      | Name     | Pincode | Address       |
      | Chemist1 | 12345   | 123 Main St   |
    And no new Prescription is pending for the Chemist
    When the Chemist's details are deleted
    Then the Chemist's details should be deleted
    And the Chemist should no longer be displayed
    Given a Lab with the following details exists:
      | Name     | Pincode | Address       |
      | Lab1     | 12345   | 456 Elm St    |
    And no new Prescription is pending for the Lab
    When the Lab's details are deleted
    Then the Lab's details should be deleted
    And the Lab should no longer be displayed
```
